title: Who checks the picture
topic: Dallas brush truck cameras move from a curbside image to city review and resident response

divergence_note: A passing street camera creates an illustrated photo that travels to a review desk; the film then shifts to a separate reported homeowner case. This residential chain, roof detail, and unresolved handoff differs from the prior empty freight cab and Denton civic vote in subjects, movement, scale, setting, and human consequence.

fingerprint.palette: slate street, cream paper, copper mark

fauna_scope.reason: No animal contributes to the city camera workflow or the documented resident consequence.

cinema.visible_action: A moving brush truck carries a fixed side camera past a house; an illustrated photo moves into the city review process, then the film turns to a reported resident notice.
cinema.human_consequence: A Dallas homeowner said a camera notice sent her into extreme heat to clean her yard while she disputed the roof flag.
cinema.source_limit: The September city memo and Morrison’s roof documentation were not inspected directly, and no resolution of her disputed flag was found.

throughline.subject: the recurring camera image and notice motif, shifting explicitly to a separate reported resident case
throughline.opening_state: The house is seen only from a moving truck
throughline.closing_state: The notice and roof documentation remain at home with no reported resolution

cinematic_contract.button: The city describes human review; the reported resident dispute has no published outcome.

documentary.viewer_question: Who checks a camera image before it changes a resident’s day?
documentary.payoff: The city describes a path from camera image to human review; a separately reported notice reaches a home.
documentary.source_limit: The cited September city memo and Morrison’s own roof documentation were not independently inspected; her disputed flag has no confirmed resolution.
documentary.hero_image: A brush truck camera catches a house while a cream photo lifts out of its side lens.
documentary.closing_answer: The city requires a person in the loop; the available reports leave this resident’s roof dispute unresolved.
